# guard does NOT catch (aliasing, indirection, reflection, type blindness) before trusting it.
#   path <TAB> count <TAB> normalised code line <TAB> reason

# next reader cannot tell a ruled-legitimate read from one somebody silenced to get a green build.

# A STALE entry - one that no longer matches any read - ALSO fails, so this file cannot quietly
# accumulate cover for reads that no longer exist.

# types that are not CheckResult at all, or reads already inside the classification discipline.
# Three carry the reason "NOT RULED"/"NOT independently reviewed this round" - they are real
# CheckResult reads whose behaviour is described honestly rather than blessed. They are debt this
# guard now makes visible; they are not claimed to be correct.
